decks.notes: The deck centers around using cards like Replenish, Opalescence, Parallax Tide, and Parallax Wave to create a loop that allows for repeated removal of opponent's permanents while also generating value by recurring enchantments from the graveyard. The combo relies on setting up the pieces through card draw and mana acceleration, while also having disruption tools like Mana Leak and Seal of Cleansing to control the board. The strategy aims to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board presence and disrupt their game plan effectively.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle combo to create a powerful threat on the board while countering opponent's spells and disrupting their strategy. The deck includes various cantrips and counterspells to find and protect the combo pieces, making it a fast and aggressive strategy that aims to win the game before the opponent can establish a solid board state. The deck's goal is to efficiently and effectively control the game while setting up a game-winning combo.

The main objective of this Aggro - Sligh (RDW) deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and efficient damage-dealing creatures and burn spells. The deck focuses on dealing direct damage to the opponent while maintaining a fast and aggressive pace to pressure them into submission. The inclusion of various burn spells and creature cards with haste allows for a quick and relentless assault on the opponent's life total, ultimately aiming to win the game before the opponent can stabilize or mount a significant defense.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble and protect the combo of Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle to create a powerful threat that can win the game in a single turn. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Duress and Counterspell while generating card advantage with Gush and Portent. Lim-Dûl's Vault helps to dig for combo pieces, while Psychatog provides an alternate win condition. The deck uses a combination of control elements and efficient card draw to set up the game-winning combo.

This aggressive deck is focused on dealing quick and consistent damage to the opponent. It includes powerful and efficient burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Incinerate, as well as creatures like Jackal Pup and Grim Lavamancer. The deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent while conserving resources for direct damage spells like Fireblast and Price of Progress. With a focus on speed and efficiency, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with elves and utilizing various creature abilities. It aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of powerful creatures like Verdant Force and Phantom Nishoba, supported by efficient mana-producing elves like Priest of Titania and Fyndhorn Elves. Natural Order and Survival of the Fittest provide additional flexibility in searching for key creatures like Deranged Hermit or Kamahl, Fist of Krosa. The deck also includes some removal and card advantage options like Anger and Squee, Goblin Nabob to maintain pressure and resilience throughout the game.

This Mono Black Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand and field using cards like Duress and Diabolic Edict, while applying pressure with creatures like Hypnotic Specter and Skittering Skirge. The Rack is used to deal damage and Bottomless Pit forces the opponent to discard. The deck also includes removal spells like Innocent Blood and Cabal Therapy. Wasteland and Mishra's Factory disrupt the opponent's mana base, while Cursed Scroll provides additional direct damage. Overall, the deck aims to control the game through disruption and efficient threats.

The deck focuses on using Phyrexian Dreadnought's ability to create a powerful creature with a low mana cost, while using a combination of Stifle and various card draw and control cards to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It aims to quickly assemble the combo and efficiently control the game to secure victory.

This deck aims to quickly assemble and execute a powerful combo involving Hermit Druid, Nomads en-Kor, and Cephalid Illusionist to mill the entire deck and put key creatures into the graveyard. Reanimation spells like Reanimate and Exhume are used to bring back high-impact creatures like Sutured Ghoul and Terravore to overwhelm the opponent. The deck includes a range of spells like Living Wish and Duress for tutoring and disruption, creating a versatile and potent combo strategy capable of winning the game in a single explosive turn.

The main focus of this Aggro - Sligh (RDW) deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle. By utilizing low-cost and efficient creatures like Mogg Fanatic and Jackal Pup, along with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Incinerate, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The addition of cards like Sulfuric Vortex and Fireblast further enhances the deck's ability to pressure the opponent and end the game swiftly. With a focus on speed and direct damage, this deck is designed to secure victories through aggressive tactics.

This deck focuses on assembling the combo of Tinker and Fling to deal a large amount of damage to the opponent in a single turn. The deck includes cards like Phyrexian Devourer and Altar of Dementia to fuel the combo, along with ways to search for key pieces like Impulse and Chromatic Sphere. Defense Grid and Tangle Wire help protect the combo from disruption, while mana acceleration from cards like Mind Stone and Ancient Tomb help to quickly set up the win condition. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo and win before the opponent can react.

The deck focuses on quickly playing enchantments to buff creatures and draw cards while utilizing mana acceleration to ramp up the board presence. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and efficient card advantage, utilizing synergy between enchantments and enchantress creatures. The deck's strategy revolves around creating a fast and powerful board state that can pressure the opponent and quickly close out the game. By efficiently utilizing resources and maximizing card draw, the deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver opponents in a quick and aggressive manner.

This deck focuses on utilizing the aggressive power of goblins to overwhelm the opponent quickly. By using cards like Goblin Lackey to cheat out powerful goblins early, and cards like Goblin Warchief to reduce the cost of goblins, this deck aims to swarm the opponent with a horde of creatures. Cards like Diabolic Edict and Siege-Gang Commander provide removal and additional reach if the game goes longer. With a mix of card advantage, removal, and efficient creatures, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful enchantments such as Standstill. The key strategy is to stall the game with Standstill while using efficient removal and countermagic to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Once the board is stabilized, the deck can win with powerful finishers like Decree of Justice. The deck also has land denial elements with cards like Dust Bowl to further control the game and limit the opponent's resources.

The deck focuses on locking down the opponent's resources with the enchantment Stasis, while using cards like Gush and Forsaken City to untap lands and generate extra mana. The goal is to control the game until you can assemble the combo of Stasis and Forsaken City to lock the opponent out of the game. It also uses counterspells and removal like Chain of Vapor and Pyroclasm to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to outlast the opponent and eventually win through incremental advantage and resource denial.

This deck focuses on aggressive play by quickly ramping up mana with Mox Diamond and Armageddon to put pressure on the opponent. Terravore serves as a powerful finisher that becomes larger as lands are sacrificed. The deck also includes disruption and removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Wasteland to control the board. Weathered Wayfarer helps find specific lands needed, while Sylvan Library provides card advantage. The deck aims to outpace the opponent by overwhelming them with threats while disrupting their game plan.
